versions.short: The bill would direct federal agencies to improve how wildfires are prepared for, detected, and fought, and how land is recovered afterward. Its main areas are: firefighting spending transparency and reimbursement from military training fires; fire management planning and studies on training local firefighters; wildfire detection equipment, slip-on water tanker units, and drone research and drone-interference studies; and post-fire recovery, including online guides to disaster assistance, emergency burned-area response teams, and long-term rehabilitation of burned land.
